# POD Builder — Decisions

One line per decision the builder took without the owner (charter §3).
Format:

`- YYYY-MM-DD · <queue item> · <question> → <choice> (reason) · PR #n`

The owner reviews this file. Any line he disagrees with becomes a fix item in
`queue.md` (and, if it is a general rule, a ruling in `charter.md` §5).
